candidates.change_summary: Replace the safe increment of balances[msg.sender] with an unchecked subtraction (buggy write) causing balances to decrease by msg.value instead of increase.
Replace the addition to balances[msg.sender] with storing only msg.value (resetting previous balance), so deposit overwrites instead of accumulates.
Insert a transfer of the received value to the contract owner (external address 0x000...001) before updating balances, causing actual contract balance and recorded balances to diverge for some keys.

Replace the call to Log.AddMessage with a different log string 'Taken', leaving balances update intact but changing observable history which may affect keys used by checker that examine logs alongside balances.
Delete the balances update so Deposit only logs but does not change balances, causing balances to differ after deposit.
